hooks.command: python3 -c "import sys,json,os; d=json.loads(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT','{}')); sys.exit(0 if 'tokens/' in d.get('file_path','') else 1)" && npm run build; exit 0

FP=$(python3 -c "import json,os; print(json.loads(os.environ.get('CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT','{}')).get('file_path',''))") && [[ "$FP" == *.css ]] && MATCHES=$(grep -n ':focus[^-]' "$FP" 2>/dev/null) && echo "Warning: use :focus-visible, not :focus:" && echo "$MATCHES"; exit 0

git diff HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'tokens/' && ! git diff HEAD --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'CHANGELOG' && echo 'Reminder: tokens/ was modified — did you update CHANGELOG.md?'; exit 0
